verdict: MATCHED-ENTROPY PREFIX PAIRS, registered in experiments/prereg_matched_entropy.json. The pairing was frozen by phase 1 before any dphi existed and verified against its sha256 (9f3012b7d1ff...) before this run started. Six models, prefixes matched within 0.10 nats of induced entropy shift and differing in the corpus's own document-type label. The K1/K2 majorities below are therefore over five models, not the registered six.  pythia-410m-deduped: raw 0.4271, A 0.0 (PubMed Abstracts), B 0.0 (StackExchange); dphi -0.4271 vs -0.4271, gap 0.0 against tolerance 0.0417 -- EXCLUDED, floored/ceilinged.  SmolLM-1.7B: raw 0.5625, A 0.0 (Pile-CC), B 0.0 (Wikipedia (en)); dphi -0.5625 vs -0.5625, gap 0.0 against tolerance 0.1252 -- EXCLUDED, floored/ceilinged.  Qwen1.5-1.8B: raw 0.5104, A 0.0104 (Wikipedia (en)), B 0.0 (PubMed Abstracts); dphi -0.5 vs -0.5104, gap 0.0104 against tolerance 0.0417 -- EXCLUDED, floored/ceilinged.  Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: raw 0.5729, A 0.0 (StackExchange), B 0.0 (PubMed Abstracts); dphi -0.5729 vs -0.5729, gap 0.0 against tolerance 0.0417 -- EXCLUDED, floored/ceilinged.  Falcon3-1B-Base: raw 0.224, A 0.0 (Pile-CC), B 0.0 (Github); dphi -0.224 vs -0.224, gap 0.0 against tolerance 0.0626 -- EXCLUDED, floored/ceilinged.  CENSORING EXCLUDED 5 MODEL(S), and this is the finding rather than an aside: in each, BOTH matched-entropy prefixes drove phi onto the same boundary, so |dphi(A) - dphi(B)| is near zero because the measurement saturated and not because the prefixes were matched. Two arms pinned to one wall agree as trivially as two arms that never moved. pythia-410m-deduped -0.4271/-0.4271; SmolLM-1.7B -0.5625/-0.5625; Qwen1.5-1.8B -0.5/-0.5104; Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct -0.5729/-0.5729; Falcon3-1B-Base -0.224/-0.224.  K3 FIRES: no model has a READABLE pair -- either no arm moved beyond its own tolerance. The comparison is between two nothings and is NOT DECIDABLE. This is the outcome the anti-vacuity gate exists to produce, and it is not evidence for H1 -- two prefixes that both did nothing agree trivially.  REFUSALS, registered before the numbers: no significance test -- a paired test on six models cannot fail informatively; no correlation between entropy shift and dphi magnitude across models, which is F149's refusal. AND THE PRIOR-ART GATE FOR greedy-decoding degeneration and repetition self-reinforcement IS OWED before any entropy-mediation claim is written up -- entropy sharpening under a prefix is close to that literature's territory.
